restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday: 2^96 groups; shared m0..m14; enumerate all m15. Same search, table, VERIFY and prefixes[g] reconstruction as the 127.432 lineage; only the per-message digest evaluator changes.

Digest evaluator is lane-parallel (SWAR) on the 256-bit word RAM: the 16-lane BLAKE3 state is held as four 256-bit words A,B,C,D, each carrying four 32-bit lanes in the low halves of four 64-bit slots (high halves zero). One G4 step = 30 Word ops computes four G functions at once; carry isolation by 64-bit slots + &M4 masks (proof §2.3, Lemma S).
Slot (column/diagonal) realignment uses 256-bit word rotations by 64k bits, CHARGED 3 Word ops each (shr+shl+or); the cost model's 'rotation' primitive is NOT credited at 1.

Per-message Word ops = 127 = 103 SWAR body (2 counter-register increments + R1 diagonal 2nd half 13 + undiag 9 + R2 column G4 30 + diag 9 + R2 diagonal G4 30 + feed-forward 8 + pack 2) + 24 BT/K-compare/counter; outer unroll 3/256 in T. Group setup <=512 Word/group => <2^97 units. VERIFY Word <=640 => <2 units; T_ver compressions <=16. No expectations in T.

K_full = H0 | (H1<<32) is a fixed public bit-permutation of the 256-bit digest (equal K iff equal digest). Briggs-Torczon sparse set indexed by top 140 bits of K_full; never-cleared sparse[]; unequal-K discards without compressions; equal K_full triggers VERIFY with two reference compressions; V_max=8.

Declared score-critical heuristics: H1-grouped-digests (probability only); H-COST-BT-SPARSE (24-op envelope, unchanged); H-COST-SWAR-EVAL (103-op SWAR body, Word-metered, bit-exact vs verifier/blake3.py).
Does NOT use 21-op sparse, pack=0, BT<24, public 247 undercount, or expectation substitutions. Unkeyed BLAKE3-256; 2 rounds.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random independent group prefixes and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for bounding F1, the earliest-completing-pair F2 displacement probability conditional on existence of a collision, and F4, up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3932) and claimed success probability 0.39. Because K_full is a fixed bit-permutation of the digest, top140(K_full) is uniform under the same model.
heuristics.scope: Success-probability claim only. Does not justify expectation-for-worst-case substitutions in the time bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: Matched-scale digest-xor-mask experiments (widths 16/20/24, N_t^2/2^w=1) and single-group stress are consistency checks only; they do not establish full-scale iid behavior.
heuristics.limitations: H1 unproved. No full-scale collision known. Experiments do not support full-scale inference.

heuristics.statement: On the classical 256-bit word RAM of collision-frontier-v5, the Briggs-Torczon procedure in proof §2.4 together with the mandatory live (g||m15) counter update implements membership test, insert of (idx,K_full,g||m15), unequal-K discard and counter increment for a top-140-bit index with never-cleared sparse[] of 256-bit words in at most 24 charged primitive word operations per message.
heuristics.scope: Only the 24-op BT+counter envelope; identical to the 127.432 / 9551ae18 / c1a7e1b9 envelope. Does not cover the SWAR body, its two slot-counter increments (charged separately in the 103), group setup, or VERIFY.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard Briggs-Torczon correctness extrapolated to word-addressable sparse[0..2^140) without initialization. Analytic from the §2.4 op list.

heuristics.statement: On the classical 256-bit word RAM with organizer Word accounting (each +,&,|,^,<<,>> on a 256-bit word counts 1; results mod 2^256; no native 32-bit rotate; 256-bit word rotation charged as shr+shl+or = 3), the per-message SWAR evaluator of proof §2.3 computes K_full, a fixed bit-permutation of the exact 2-round BLAKE3 root digest, in exactly 103 Word ops: counters 2, R1 diag second half 13, undiag 9, R2 column G4 30, diag 9, R2 diagonal G4 30, feed-forward 8, pack 2.
heuristics.scope: Only the 103-op SWAR body line of the 127-op ledger. Constants M4 and 1<<192 are register-resident, as MASK is in the organizer meter.
heuristics.extrapolation: Deterministic straight-line programme; the count is identical for every message. Carry isolation (Lemma S) is proved analytically and checked by the meter on every metered message (digest and K bit-exact vs inlined reference identical to verifier/blake3.py).
heuristics.limitations: Observation op counts are harness-untrusted labels; adjudicated content is the analytic ledger plus readable meter source. If 256-bit rotation were charged >3 the body grows by 8 per extra op.
